title: bot PR-creation workflows: set GH_DEBUG=api on the gh step to log API requests when diagnosing duplicate labels or events
answers: Why are labels like team-review showing up twice on the automated model catalog or uv.lock PRs?
How do I turn on gh API request logging in a GitHub Actions step that creates or labels a bot PR?
Where is the GH_DEBUG setting for the update-model-catalog or uv.lock PR-creation step?
How can I tell whether a duplicate label comes from the client or the server side?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml (step id `pr`) and .github/workflows/uv.yml (the step that opens the uv.lock PR). Both steps run `gh` to create the bot PR and apply labels, using the mlflow-app[bot] token.
Rule: Both bot PR-creation steps set `GH_DEBUG: api` in their step `env:` block, next to `GH_TOKEN`, so the `gh` CLI logs its API requests into the Actions log. Keep this env var on those steps when investigating duplicate label or review-request events, and compare the logged requests against the PR's event history to separate client-side duplication from server-side duplication.
Symptom: Duplicate `labeled` events on bot PRs (for example team-review applied twice) cancelled a Protect run and caused a reviewer to be assigned twice, with no record in the logs of which API calls the bot made.
Constraints: This is a diagnostic setting added to find the cause; the change does not fix the duplication itself. It only affects the `gh` calls inside these two steps, not other workflows. The debug output is verbose, so search the step log rather than reading it whole.
applies: Diagnosing duplicate labels or events on bot-created PRs in the two workflows that create them; not a general logging setting for all workflows.
says: Automated bot pull requests assign reviewers twice and apply duplicate review labels.
Duplicate label events on automated pull requests are cancelling required protection checks.
Enable detailed bot request logging to troubleshoot duplicate labels on automated pull requests.
Find why automated catalog and dependency pull requests trigger repeated review assignment events.
search: To diagnose duplicate label or review-request events on bot PRs, set GH_DEBUG: api alongside GH_TOKEN in the pr step of .github/workflows/update-model-catalog.yml and the PR creation step of .github/workflows/uv.yml. This causes the gh CLI to log its API requests in GitHub Actions logs so client-side and server-side duplicate events can be distinguished. The setting is purely diagnostic, applies only to gh steps in those two workflows, and does not resolve the duplication itself.
